amendment.reason: Add a held-out seed split, one directional primary endpoint, matched lesion controls, passive-physics and sign controls, adapter and decoder permutations, explicit multiplicity, precision, and exclusion rules.

hypothesis: With identical arena, reset, sensor, actuator, seed, and tick budgets, source-derived recurrent topology contributes to at least one declared closed-loop metric relative to matched topology controls.

seed_split.freeze_rule: No controller, adapter, endpoint, threshold, exclusion, or analysis change after viewing a held-out trial.

primary_endpoint.population: held_out_confirmation seeds pooled across the two declared arenas after within-arena-seed reproducibility aggregation; paired by arena and seed
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: The paired 95 percent bootstrap interval must exclude 0 in the declared direction and the point estimate must be at least 0.10.

analysis.interval: paired bootstrap 95 percent interval with analysis seed 20260817
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across the 15 confirmatory comparison-by-metric tests; the single primary endpoint is evaluated first and reported separately.
analysis.replicate_role: The two executions per arena-seed-condition are reproducibility repeats, not independent statistical units.
analysis.replicate_aggregation: Require both repeats to complete; report disagreement, then aggregate them within arena-seed-condition before any paired comparison. Effective confirmatory units are arena-seed pairs.
analysis.precision_rule: Report paired effect, 95 percent interval, adjusted p value, completed pair count, and missing pair count for every confirmatory test.
analysis.missing_trial: report and fail the paired cell; never silently replace
analysis.exclusions: Only a predeclared infrastructure failure with no Action applied may be rerun once under the same identity. Every other failure remains an outcome; no post-outcome exclusions.

claim_boundary: This preregistration contains no trial result. A difference from a control is evidence about this implementation under these arenas, not proof of natural Drosophila behavior or recovered physiology.
